subject: Re: EgoSocial status: baseline running, audio cue risk
body:
Freya, Deshawn,

Closing this out ahead of Friday's go/no-go. The re-extraction call was right - corrected-set baseline came in at 67.8% timing accuracy, and more importantly the audio ablation gap is now stable, so the numbers are defensible.

Decisions:

1. GO on Evalline onboarding. Tomas, Quentin will hand over the eval spec Thursday; we'd like it in the shared harness before the Q3 OKR lock on June 26 so assistant teams can adopt it in planning.

2. Scope cut: the synthetic pipeline ships with the scenario generator and QA sampler only; the audio/visual compositing stage slips to Q3 since the re-extraction ate Wanjiru's April. Rare-configuration coverage stays a known gap in the v1 dataset card.

3. No external claims about EgoSoD until we've run the full 13,500-pair benchmark - one more compute burst, Deshawn has it queued.

Dmitri
